rep.partial_message: Bring your hands all the way together in front of you.

checks.label: Turning it into a press
checks.message: Keep a soft, fixed bend in your elbows and hug the weight in an arc.

checks.label: Body swinging
checks.message: Stay braced. Do not lean into the weight.

camera.title: Face the camera
steps: Prop your phone or laptop 2.5 to 3 m away at chest height, with you facing it.
Stand far enough back that both hands stay in frame at the top of every rep.
Light the room from the front or above. A bright window behind you makes the camera lose your outline.
Wear fitted clothing so your shoulders and elbows are visible.
camera.note: Stand facing the camera between the cable stacks, with both hands in view at the top and the bottom.

guidance.accuracy: Machines and cables hide parts of your body and move the load on a fixed path, so this rule tracks only the main joint angles and whether your torso stays still. Expect fewer and simpler cues than on free-weight lifts, and some missed reps if the machine covers your arms or legs.
